title: Gelée Őszi Baraczкból (Autumn Apricot Gelée)
description: Prepared with apricots, isinglass or gelatin, and white wine.
steps: Boil the sugar in 4 deciliters of water
Add the peeled and halved apricots along with the pits

Cover and let cool
Strain through a sieve, filtering the sugar through a cloth
Mix the lukewarm isinglass, strained juice of 3 lemons, and wine together
Layer the gelée with the apricots into a mold according to the method described above

title: Genois (Genoese Sponge)
description: Prepared with orange, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: Melt 14 dekagramm butter, remove the sediment and set aside to clarify completely but remain liquid, not solidify
Rub 14 dekagramm broken and sifted sugar on an orange, then beat in a bowl with 4 egg yolks for a quarter hour until foamy
Make stiff foam from 4 egg whites
At almost the same time, mix in 14 dekagramm fine dry flour with the mixture
Then quickly stir in the butter sediment only until well combined with the rest
Coat a cake tin with its ring with butter
Spread the mixture onto it in two knife-blade thicknesses smoothly
Bake at gentle heat
When baked and cooled, either cut with a two-forint-sized cutter or cut large boats from it
Coat with apricot marmalade

Using a small paper cone with an opening no larger than a pin head, pipe small dots of beautiful white frosting around the edge in an orderly pattern, leaving space for another dot between every two dots

Fill another cone with redcurrant or raspberry preserves that have been pushed through and cooked with sugar, which should be beautifully colored, and pipe red dots from the preserves between the white dots
If cutting the dough into boats, decorate the same way and arrange on a plate in a large star shape

title: Gesztenye-fagylalt (Chestnut Ice Cream)
description: Prepared with cream, ice, and chestnuts.
steps: Cook 70 dekagrams of Italian chestnuts until soft, peel them, and press through a sieve
Cook 21 dekagrams of sugar with 2 deciliters of water until it forms large bubbles while boiling and becomes thick
Finely beat the pressed chestnuts in a bowl with the cooked sugar
Add 3 tablespoons of good rum and mix well, making sure the mixture is very cold
Finally, gently fold in the stiffly beaten whipped cream of 4 deciliters of good cream
Immediately pour into the freezing container and place in finely crushed, well-salted ice
Do not turn, but let it freeze
During freezing, occasionally insert a stick around the edges of the container to mix the frozen mixture with the still-liquid part until the entire mass is frozen
Turn out, wrap with spun sugar columns, and place dipped chestnuts in the center

title: Gesztenye-pép (Chestnut Paste)
description: Prepared with chestnuts, cream, and sweet almonds.
steps: Roast the Italian chestnuts until soft without browning
Peel them and while warm grind until resembling dough
Put in a pan and mix smooth with two deciliters good cream
Boil with constant stirring
Clean eight dekagrams sweet almonds and grind as finely as the chestnuts
Press the chestnuts through a sieve and put in a pan with the almonds, twenty-one dekagrams sifted sugar, and several spoonfuls cold cream
Stew with constant stirring into a thick paste
Remove from heat and while warm mix in five dekagrams butter and cool
Gently mix in five egg yolks and stiffly beaten whites of three eggs
Butter the mold
Roast eight to ten chestnuts, peel them, and cut in half
Boil ten dekagrams sugar with half a coffee cup water until thick with large bubbles forming
Dip the chestnuts in this and place on marble, and when cool cut them in half
Line the mold with these so the sugar-coated side touches the mold side
Fill with the paste
Squeeze a lemon, strain, and boil with fourteen dekagrams sugar until large bubbles form
Cool, and when jelly-like, turn out the paste and coat with this glaze

title: Grated Dough Filled with Sweet (Reszelt tészta édesen töltve)
description: Prepared with ground almonds, egg yolks, and lemon or orange zest.
steps: Make grated dough from 2 eggs and cook it in milk
When thick and well cooked, remove from heat and cool
Into 7 dekagrams of fluffy beaten butter add the same amount of finely ground almonds and 7 egg yolks, as well as 10 dekagrams of sugar rubbed with lemon or orange zest
Stir for half an hour
Add the cooled grated dough and finally the stiff snow from 4 egg whites
Pour half the mixture into a buttered baking dish
Fill with preserved currants
Pour the other half of the mixture over it
Bake nicely and serve dusted with sugar

title: Gulyáshús á la Rottenbiller Károly (Goulash à la Charles Rottenbiller)
description: Prepared with beef, onion, and tomato.
steps: Chop the beef together as is customary, add a generous amount of red onion, and then place over heat as beef is usually prepared. Once you have removed the scum, salt sufficiently and add one whole tomato. When the tomato has become soft, remove it, press it through a sieve, and return it to the pot. When the meat begins to soften, add peeled and chopped potatoes and when these are cooked, serve the goulash. Instead of potatoes, separately made dumplings can also be served alongside the goulash.

description: Prepared with egg whites, sugar, and flour.

ingredients.name: butter for coating the sheet pan
ingredients.sourceText: butter for coating the sheet pan

steps: Mix the finely ground sugar and fine flour well together
Fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites
Spread the mixture onto a buttered sheet pan with a wide knife to paper-thin thickness

Sprinkle evenly with coarsely broken sugar
Return to the oven until it becomes a light golden yellow
Cut into strips as long as a hand-span and as wide as a finger with a sharp knife
Roll quickly onto a cylindrical form of finger thickness to resemble wafer shavings
Heap high on a serving plate and serve with any milk-based glaze

description: Prepared with vanilla, egg yolks, and powdered sugar.

ingredients.name: 7 dekagrams butter beaten to a foam
ingredients.sourceText: 7 dekagrams butter beaten to a foam

steps: Mix 6 cooking spoonfuls of flour finely with 7 deciiliters of cold milk, adding the milk gradually to the flour so it does not become lumpy
Place on charcoal fire and stir constantly until thick, then cool
Mix the paste into 7 dekagrams of foamy butter
Add 1 whole egg and 6 egg yolks and mix together
Add powdered sugar and powdered vanilla to taste
Stir for half an hour
Finally fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites
Place the paste in a buttered pot and put in a steam bath

Make small cones from common wafer batter, treat them like regular waffles but use a rolling pin that is sharpened fine at the bottom instead of a round one, bake the wafer smaller and wrap it around this rolling pin to make small cones

ingredients.name: two whole eggs and four egg yolks
ingredients.sourceText: two whole eggs and four egg yolks

Beat 4 dekagramm butter until fluffy
Mix in the cooled baby cereal
Add two whole eggs and four egg yolks and stir for half an hour

Spread the baby cereal filling on it to the thickness of a knife blade
Fold it together gently
Place it in a butter-brushed pan and bake until golden

title: Gyümölcs-eczet (Fruit Vinegar)
description: Prepared with fruit, apples or pears, and wine.

ingredients.name: 2 deciliters of good wine vinegar per 6 liters
ingredients.sourceText: 2 deciliters of good wine vinegar per 6 liters

steps: Collect rotted apples, rotted pears, and all manner of fruit scraps and peels in a water-tight barrel kept open in the cellar from autumn through winter
In spring or when you have time, press the collected fruit and place the juice in a clean vessel
Leave it to stand for 2-4 days so that the thick impure part gathers on top and can be removed
Place that juice in the vinegar barrel and put it in a moderately warm room, and after a few weeks you will obtain good strong vinegar
Alternatively: throw rotted fruit into a barrel standing in a warm location, shake it together and pour 16 liters of water into a 90-liter barrel
Bring the fruit temperature to 18-20° R if possible
During fermentation, stir the mixture well
After 3-4 weeks, depending on how warm or cool the barrel is, draw off the liquid and press out the remainder
Place the obtained cloudy liquid in another barrel, and for every 6 liters add 6 deciliters of good wine vinegar and 2 deciliters of brandy, and place the barrel in a warm location
Later, separate the fruit vinegar from its sediment

title: Gyümölcsös rizs (Fruit Rice)
description: Prepared with rice, cream, and apricot or raspberry or marmalade.

ingredients.name: one and one-quarter kilograms of picked and washed rice
ingredients.sourceText: one and one-quarter kilograms of picked and washed rice

ingredients.name: apricot or raspberry marmalade
ingredients.sourceText: three tablespoons of apricot or raspberry marmalade

ingredients.name: candied peach, orange, melon slices, pineapple, Reine Claude plums, Spanish cherries, or sour cherries
ingredients.sourceText: candied peach, orange, melon slices, pineapple, Reine Claude plums, Spanish cherries, or sour cherries

steps: Cook the picked and well-washed rice in seven decilitres of cream until soft, add eighteen dekagrams of pounded sugar and a little salt, then cool it
Meanwhile, mix {{source-4}} with sugar finely pounded and sifted on orange or lemon zest, then mix in the juice of half a lemon, and finally slowly mix in the stiffly beaten snow of six egg whites

Place one-third of the rice in a deep porcelain pan buttered with butter and spread it evenly, arrange candied fruits in syrup on it, such as apricot, orange, melon slices, pineapple, Reine Claude, Spanish cherry, or sour cherry
Spread the second third of the rice on top, arrange it again with fruit, and cover with the remaining rice
Then shape a peak from the apricot or raspberry foam on top of the rice with a silver spoon, and bake the whole in the oven at gentle heat for half an hour, then serve immediately on the table
If this dish succeeds, it has a very beautiful appearance and splendid flavor

Meanwhile, mix three tablespoons of apricot or raspberry marmalade with sugar finely pounded and sifted on orange or lemon zest, then mix in the juice of half a lemon, and finally slowly mix in the stiffly beaten snow of six egg whites

Place one-third of the rice in a deep porcelain pan buttered with butter and spread it evenly, arrange candied fruits in syrup on it, such as apricot, orange, melon slices, pineapple, Reine Claude, Spanish cherry, or sour cherry
Spread the second third of the rice on top, arrange it again with fruit, and cover with the remaining rice
Then shape a peak from the apricot or raspberry foam on top of the rice with a silver spoon, and bake the whole in the oven at gentle heat for half an hour, then serve immediately on the table
If this dish succeeds, it has a very beautiful appearance and splendid flavor

title: Gőzmetélt (Steamed Noodles)
description: Prepared with cream, egg yolks, and melted butter.
steps: Warm the flour in a bowl and salt it, add 1 spoon of broken sugar
Mix together the lukewarm cream, 5 egg yolks, melted butter, and cheese yeast
Take as much of the flour as needed for making the dough, then pour the entire mixture through a sieve onto the flour and stir until the dough separates from the spoon
Stir a little more, but it should not be too stiff even though it is difficult to work
Place on a well-floured board and roll out to the thickness of two knife-backs
Cut out the noodles with a medium-sized pastry cutter and let rise
Place an egg-sized piece of butter, an equal amount of sugar, and milk to a depth of two finger-widths in a flat, wide pan, bring to a boil, and add the noodles when well risen
Cover with clean paper and then with a well-fitting iron lid, steam for 15-30 minutes

While this is cooking, prepare the sauce: mix 5 egg yolks, {{source-11}}, a little vanilla, and {{source-13}} in a pot, place over coals and constantly stir so it does not curdle, until it begins to thicken
Pour into a bowl, place the noodles on a platter, sprinkle with sugar, and serve with the sauce

steps: Place preserved apricot in a bowl

ingredients.sourceText: zest of one orange, finely chopped

steps: Finely grind soaked almonds while moistening with water to prevent them from becoming oily

title: Habart mandolatorta (Whipped Almond Cake)
description: A cake made with almonds, lemon, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: 28 dekagrams softened and finely pounded almonds
ingredients.sourceText: 28 dekagrams softened and finely pounded almonds

steps: Place the softened and finely pounded almonds, the same amount of finely pounded sugar, and the finely chopped zest of one lemon in a bowl, into which beat 2 whole eggs and 6 egg yolks one after another and whip this for half an hour

The duration of whipping cannot be precisely determined; generally it is enough when the batter is already white and begins to rise in the bowl; it must never be whipped so long that it falls together again, otherwise the cake will be very hard
Once the batter is good, gently mix in the stiff snow of 3 egg whites, place the mixture in a mold greased with butter, and bake slowly

A whipped cake must never be exposed to great heat; once it is baked, which can be easily determined with a testing needle, turn it out and cool it and cover it with such a chocolate icing whose preparation method is found in no. 683

title: Habart Meggy-Lepény (Stirred Sour Cherry Cake)
description: A cake made with ground almonds, egg yolks, and egg whites.

ingredients.name: 14 dekagrams soaked and finely ground almonds
ingredients.sourceText: 14 dekagrams soaked and finely ground almonds

steps: Place the finely ground almonds and sugar in a bowl with finely chopped lemon zest
Add roll crumbs that are dry enough to grate
Beat 1 whole egg and 6 egg yolks over the mixture and stir for half an hour
Finally fold in stiffly beaten 5 egg whites
Coat a baking dish with butter
Line the bottom completely with sour cherries
Fill half with the batter
Bake in the oven until the dough is firm enough that the cherries do not sink
Slightly pull the baking dish out from the oven without removing it
Completely line the baked dough with more cherries
Top with the remaining batter
Bake completely
For the same cake with currants or raspberries: clean and wash 10 dekagrams of the finest berries and let them drain on a sieve until dry

title: Habart tejfelpép (Stirred Cream Pap)
description: Prepared with cream, ground almonds, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: flour (amount to absorb 5-6 tablespoons of butter)
ingredients.sourceText: flour (amount to absorb 5-6 tablespoons of butter)

steps: Prepare wafer cones and many small pasta pieces
Make a béchamel from the milk
Add the pasta pieces (double the amount of the béchamel), the finely ground almonds, sugar to taste, and a small amount of ground vanilla to a pot
Pour 4 decilitres of cream over it and cook to a pap consistency with continuous stirring, thinning with more milk if too thick
Cool the mixture
Beat 6 egg yolks into the cooled mixture one by one until well foamed
Gently fold in the stiff foam of a few egg whites
Butter a mould and coat it densely with small pasta pieces
Fill with the pap and steam for three-quarters of an hour
When serving, turn out and arrange the wafer cones in a neat order, fill the cones with compote, and serve quickly

title: Habart élesztős tészta (Whipped Yeast Dough)
description: Prepared with sour cream, egg yolks, and fruit or berries or filling.

ingredients.name: 14 dekagrams sour cream with dissolved yeast
ingredients.sourceText: 14 dekagrams sour cream with dissolved yeast

ingredients.name: preserved fruit or berries for filling
ingredients.sourceText: preserved fruit or berries for filling

steps: Beat the butter until foamy
Combine the sour cream, egg yolks, and yeast dissolved in sour cream and mix well
Strain through a sieve and add slowly to the beaten butter, one spoonful at a time
Never add more than one spoonful at a time and only after the previous one is well beaten in
Add a little salt and ground sugar
When all the mixture is combined, add half kilogram flour, beat well and prepare a stick dough
Spread the dough rolled to the thickness of a new hand on a butter-coated pastry leaf
Arrange with preserved fruit or berries and decorate with strips made from the remaining dough
Make a border around the edge of the leaf and bake at sustained heat
Before placing in the oven, it must rise like all yeast dough, then brush with egg white and sprinkle thickly with coarsely broken sugar and almonds

title: Habos citrom-pép (Foamy Lemon Paste)
description: Prepared with juice, egg yolks, and egg whites.

ingredients.name: 18 dekagramm sugar lightly rubbed with lemon
ingredients.sourceText: 18 dekagramm sugar lightly rubbed with lemon

steps: Crush 18 dekagramm sugar lightly rubbed with lemon, place in a pan, and squeeze the juice of 2 lemons over it.
Keep on low heat until the lemon dissolves, then set aside.
Once cooled, beat in 8 egg yolks one after another.
Return to low heat and stir constantly until it begins to steam and becomes slightly thick.
Remove from heat and stir until cold.
Gently fold in the stiffly beaten whites of 8 eggs.
Heap into a porcelain pan to form a peak, smooth with a wide knife, and create spiral formations with a demitasse spoon.
Form a mushroom shape on top, sprinkle with fine sugar, and bake at very gentle heat or cook in a bain-marie.
Serve quickly at table once light brown, as this paste is delicate and collapses easily.

This paste can also be made with orange: for 8 eggs, use one large soup orange, lightly rub the sugar with the zest, squeeze the juice of one lemon and one orange over it, and otherwise prepare as with lemon.

Pour into a mold, set on ice until frozen

title: Haluska tölcsértésztával, párban (Noodles with Cone-shaped Paste, Steamed)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, ground almonds, and cream.
steps: Cream 10 dekagrams butter
Add 1 whole egg and 4 egg yolks one after another and whisk
Season lightly with salt and add only enough flour to resemble light noodle dough
Fill a syringe with smooth round tube with this dough and pre-wet it with warm milk so the dough does not stick
Push the dough into hot milk cutting equal pieces with a knife continuously
Add a piece of sugar to the milk in which the extruded noodles are cooking
Remove with a skimming spoon when cooked and set aside
Make a thick pap from 4 deciliters milk, a few tablespoons flour, and sugar stirring continuously until smooth
When well cooked place a pot lid on iron legs with good coals underneath
When the tin-plated part of the lid which should be on top is well heated, quickly coat with butter
Place a spoonful of pap on it and spread out
Leave for a few minutes until it adheres to the bottom
Scrape it off with a wide knife leaving as much as a sheet of paper
When it begins to brown coat with butter and cut rectangular leaves
Roll these on a small wooden piece which is thicker on top and pointed below and about finger-length to form cone shapes
Continue until you have enough cones to abundantly fill the dough
Make large round sheets from the rest of the dough the size of the pot you plan to use
Coat the pot well with butter and on the bottom place a baked dough sheet
Add a row of noodles sprinkled with sugar, vanilla, and 9 dekagrams crushed almonds with shell
Then another sheet etc. until the pot is full
Whisk together 4 deciliters good cream or if the pot is larger somewhat more with sugar, vanilla, and 5 egg yolks and pour over
Place in a steam bath and leave for three-quarters of an hour
Then unmold and arrange the cones in nice order around it
Fill the cones with peach or currant jam

title: Harlequin Cake (Harlekin-lepény)
description: Prepared with wafer, dough, and almonds.
steps: Using the waffle iron, bake 10-12 round wafers
Prepare puff dough and roll it as fine as noodle dough, line a wide flat baking pan with it smoothly
Finely crush 21 dekagrams of soaked almonds, moistening with water during crushing
Crush the same amount of sugar finely and sift it, then place both in a bowl, add 8 egg yolks and stir until white and fluffy

Divide into three parts: to the first part add 2 tablespoons of powdered sugar rubbed with orange, to the second part add 2 bars of finely grated chocolate, to the third part add 1.5 dekagrams of green almonds and the same amount of quince slices preserved in syrup and 4 or 5 green preserved walnuts, all cut into small cubes, and mix this with the almond mixture
Divide the stiff meringue from 6 egg whites into three parts and gently fold into each mixture

Place the portion with the orange sugar into the lined pan, cover with a wafer sheet, place the second mixture on top and cover again with a wafer sheet, finally place the fruited mixture in the oven and bake in gentle but sustained heat
When baked, turn out, cool slightly and serve dusted with sugar

title: Hermstádt élesztője (Hermstadt Yeast for Bread and Cake Baking)
description: A cake made with malt, barley, and hops.

ingredients.name: with 10 dekagrams of good hops
ingredients.sourceText: 14 liters with 10 dekagrams of good hops

steps: From coarsely ground wheat and barley malt, prepare the required amount of spiced liquor
Boil in a pot until only 12 liters remain
Before the liquid has reduced to this amount, add approximately 14 liters containing 10 dekagrams of good hops, then boil down to the stated amount
Strain the liquid and press out the remaining hops
Mix 7 kilograms of coarse wheat flour with enough cold running water to form a thick paste
Pour this into the prepared liquid and stir well together
Let this mixture stand in a place with a temperature of 14° R. for 30 hours, after which the yeast is ready for use
In summer it keeps for 3 weeks in a cool cellar; in winter for two months
To prepare fresh yeast, this yeast can be used to start fermentation

title: Hideg Pástétom (Cold Pâté)
description: Prepared with bacon, venison or rabbit or meat, and bread.
steps: Finely chop 28 dekagrams bacon and roasted venison or rabbit meat, removing meat from bones
Grate 5 bread roll crusts and cook the insides in good meat broth
Mix the finely chopped meat with bacon
Add 5 egg yolks and mix well
Pass through a sieve
Add ground black pepper, nutmeg flower, and salt
Braise 3 goose livers in butter
Roast 2 pheasants and 2 partridges, cut them up, and remove meat from bones
Slice 10-12 truffle mushrooms and braise with butter and green parsley
Prepare crumbly pastry from {{source-14}} and 750 dekagrams flour (this pastry should be less crumbly than usual to hold the filling, so use more flour than butter)
Make a pâté of ordinary form with a much higher crown
Layer the filling with alternating rows: filling, truffle mushrooms, braised goose liver pieces, truffle mushrooms again, more filling, pheasant and partridge pieces, and so on until full
Close with pastry as usual
Decorate the top with pastry dough if desired
Brush with egg white and bake at steady heat for two hours
After removing from the oven, cool it
Cut the lid quite large and fill the interior of the pâté with aspic

ingredients.sourceText: 10 decagrams violet leaves, cleaned of all green parts

title: Jó házi írósvajas tészta (Good Homemade Butter Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with butter, powdered sugar, and hazelnut.
steps: Take 250 grams of flour and 250 grams of fresh firm butter
Work half of the flour with the butter and a little salt using a rolling pin into a dough
When finely worked, roll out to the size of a plate and place on ice

Make strudel dough with the other half of flour, a little salt, one tablespoon powdered sugar, one hazelnut-sized piece of butter, one teaspoon rum, four egg yolks, and as much milk as it will take up
Work until small bubbles form on it and it separates from the board, which shows it is well worked
Shape into a loaf and let rest for one hour
Roll the dough quite thin
Place the butter dough on it and roll together quite thin
Fold as one folds a tablecloth and let rest for half an hour in a cold place
Roll out three times at half-hour intervals
Cut with a hot knife as desired
Brush with egg
Sprinkle generously with blanched chopped almonds with sugar
Bake quickly at a hot fire; small kipferl or cream-filled pastries can also be made from it

title: Jó Kalács Sütésmódja (Good Brioche Baking Method)
description: Prepared with yeast, egg yolk, and milk.

ingredients.name: 1.25 dekagrams fresh yeast dissolved in milk
ingredients.sourceText: 1.25 dekagrams fresh yeast dissolved in milk

ingredients.name: For finer brioche: 3 liters flour, 1.5 liters milk, 6 dekagrams softened cheese yeast, salt, 1 whole egg, 2 egg yolks, 28 dekagrams butter
ingredients.sourceText: For finer brioche: 3 liters flour, 1.5 liters milk, 6 dekagrams softened cheese yeast, salt, 1 whole egg, 2 egg yolks, 28 dekagrams butter

ingredients.name: For economical good brioche: 1 liter fine flour, 1 whole egg, 1 egg yolk, 1 tablespoon sugar, 2 dekagrams cheese yeast dissolved in milk, 4 dekaliters lukewarm good milk, 7 dekagrams pure lard
ingredients.sourceText: For economical good brioche: 1 liter fine flour, 1 whole egg, 1 egg yolk, 1 tablespoon sugar, 2 dekagrams cheese yeast dissolved in milk, 4 dekaliters lukewarm good milk, 7 dekagrams pure lard

steps: Prepare a starter (pâte) from 4 dekaliters lukewarm milk and 1.25 dekagrams fresh yeast dissolved in milk
Mix finely with more milk (this is essential with yeast)
Place in bowl and beat well, adding only as much flour as 4 dekaliters milk will wet
Set in a warm place until well risen
Warm the remaining milk and add {{source-3}}
Salt the flour and prepare the dough with the milk
Once the dough is well worked so no more flour or milk is needed, add the starter to the center and knead well
Note: knead with open fingers, not with fists as for bread
After kneading awhile, add 1 egg yolk and continue kneading
When dough separates from hand, move it to one side of the trough
Clean the trough and melt 18 dekagrams butter
Coat the trough and your hands with it and continue kneading
Coat the other side of the trough and repeat until all butter is kneaded in and dough forms bubbles
Then knead lightly with fists for a few minutes, fold together, dust with flour, cover and let rise well
Once well risen, form small pieces
Let them rest 15 minutes, then braid the brioche
Heat the oven while the dough rises so it is ready when the brioche is formed
The brioche should rise for at most 15 minutes before baking
Place on buttered paper and brush with beaten egg before putting in the oven

For finer brioche: use 3 liters flour to 1.5 liters milk; make starter from 4 dekaliters milk and 6 dekagrams softened cheese yeast; when well risen, salt flour, sweeten well, add 1 whole egg and 2 egg yolks; prepare dough with remaining milk; knead 28 dekagrams butter in three portions using same method

For economical brioche: salt 1 liter fine flour in a bowl; in a pitcher whisk 1 whole egg, 1 egg yolk, and 1 tablespoon sugar; mix in 2 dekagrams cheese yeast dissolved in milk; add 4 dekaliters lukewarm good milk; pour this onto the flour and knead with right hand until dough is smooth
Now add 7 dekagrams pure cold lard and knead until hand is clean and dough forms small bubbles; cover with cloth and let rise in warm place
Divide the entire mass into 4 pieces on a flour-dusted board, knead them, and form two brioche from them

title: Kabinet-pudding (Cabinet Pudding)
description: A pudding made with cream, powdered sugar, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: candied pear slices (half yellow, half red)
ingredients.sourceText: candied pear slices (half yellow, half red)

steps: When 7 deciliters of boiled thick cream has cooled, mix in 21 dekagrams powdered sugar, {{source-2}}, and 10 egg yolks in a pot
Place on charcoal fire and stir constantly until it begins to thicken
Remove quickly from heat, pour into another pot, and continue stirring to prevent curdling
Let cool completely
Whip 4 deciliters of good cream on cracked ice with a whisk until stiff
Cool 4.5 dekagrams of dissolved isinglass completely
When the egg mixture is completely cold and thickened, fold in the whipped cream and isinglass so the entire mixture becomes foamy
Add more powdered sugar if needed
Coat the mold with fine fresh almond oil

Prepare candied cherries (half yellow, half red), cut pear slices into thin leaves and cut out circles and crescents with small cutters, also cut thin strips for stems, and prepare large candied rowan berries
Arrange a beautiful wreath of pear, rowan, and cherry around the mold's circumference
Cut green almonds into leaves and arrange a beautiful rose or star in the center with almond and red pear
Fill the mold halfway with foamy mixture
Place in cracked ice, cover the mold, and place ice on top so it freezes quickly
If too hard and fruit sinks, place remaining fruit (except rowan) in the center
Bury the mold well in ice and let freeze through
After 2-3 hours, dip the mold briefly in warm water and turn out

title: Kajszinbaracзk-lepény angol tésztában (Apricot Pastry in English Dough)
description: A pastry dish made with egg yolks, walnut, and sour cream.
steps: Place 280 grams flour on a work surface
Press 3 hard-boiled egg yolks through a sieve and add with salt and {{source-3}}, mixing well with flour
Make a well in the flour, add a walnut-sized piece of butter, 2 raw egg yolks, and a coffee cup fresh sour cream
Knead into dough, adding water if not moist enough; the dough should be firmer than strudel dough
Knead until it separates from your hands, fold together, cover with cloth, and let rest half an hour
Roll out to little-finger thickness
Work 280 grams chilled clarified butter until smooth, shape into a long sheet with your palm, and wrap in dough folding the dough over from all four sides as for butter dough
Cover and let rest 15 minutes; in summer place between two plates on ice
Roll out as thin as possible, fold together again, let rest, and repeat this process three times total
For the fourth rolling, roll to knife-blade thickness, cut 5 or 6 round leaves with a warm knife
Each leaf should be slightly smaller than your little finger in diameter
Make two-finger-width incisions of equal depth with a warm knife, brush incision edges with egg white, and fold the two sides up and together so the leaf looks woven into tabs
Brush with egg white and bake to beautiful roll color
One hour before baking, peel well-ripened apricots and cut in half at the center, or use canned apricots
Place on a large plate, sprinkle generously with sugar, turn several times
Strain the canned apricot liquid
When the leaves are beautifully baked, arrange apricots on the leaf up to the tabs, sprinkle well with sugar, and return to the oven for 8-10 minutes
Cook the apricot liquid with sugar in a pan, stirring frequently until it becomes light syrup
Arrange the filled leaves on a cloth-covered plate, largest leaf first and smallest last (so place the most beautiful apricots on the smallest leaf)
Coat the fruit with syrup using a knife, sprinkle the whole pastry with sugar, and serve warm

title: Kajszinbaraezkot Befőzni (Preserved Apricots - First Method)
description: Prepared with apricots, syrup, and sugar.
steps: Peel well-ripened apricots after removing the pits and press through a sieve. Cook them with fifty-six dekagrams of sugar and one glass of water. During cooking, continuously remove the scum to make it completely clean. When it begins to form heavy drops, add the syrup. For fifty-six dekagrams of sugar, add seventy dekagrams of syrup and cook quickly, always stirring well so it does not burn. When a test drop from the preserve does not run on a plate but stays in place, it is done cooking. Remove from heat and pour into jars.

title: Kappan-tekeres (Capon Roll)
description: A bread preparation made with capon, marrow, and bacon.

Spread the whole capon on a clean board and press as evenly as possible
Finely chop together seven dekagrams marrow, seven dekagrams bacon, {{source-3}} and a little salt

Tie very securely and cook in acidic root vegetables for one and a half to two hours
Set aside in a cool place
For serving, remove the roll from the broth, unwrap it and cut into beautiful even slices
Arrange on a long platter and decorate with cutout aspic leaves

title: Kappanmell (Roasted Capon Breast)
description: Prepared with capon or turkey, bread, and carrot.

ingredients.name: breast of a fine capon or young turkey

ingredients.name: one and a half bread rolls, skin

steps: Cut out the breast of a fine capon or young turkey. Grate the skin of one and a half bread rolls and cut into thin slices, moisten with two decilitres of milk, add nine dekagrams of butter, place over charcoal and stir continuously, beating in three whole eggs, and stew into a thick paste that should separate from the spoon, then let it cool.
Pound the cut capon breast with a little salt and mace finely together in a large mortar and press through a sieve.

Braise the rest of the capon in a pot with butter, a few slices of carrot and red onion until light golden, pour in a little broth from time to time, and when the meat is tender, remove the bones and cut into thin slices.

Put the forcemeat into a bowl and beat with five egg yolks until frothy, finally mix in the stiff snow of five egg whites and the cut meat, fill into a pot greased with butter, steam for one hour, then turn out and pour over it the broth that remained from braising the capon and has been cleared of all fat.

title: Karlsbadi Marhahús (Carlsbad Beef)
description: Prepared with beef, bacon, and tongue.

ingredients.name: about four and a half kilograms of top round beef
ingredients.sourceText: about four and a half kilograms of top round beef

steps: Pound a cleaned piece of top round beef until broad and salt it
Cut thin strips of bacon and pickled tongue
Finely mince red onion, four button mushrooms, and green parsley, add black pepper and mix well
Mix the minced bacon with this mixture
Remove the bones from the meat and make small holes in the inner side of the flattened meat without piercing through or damaging the outer side
Alternately stuff with the prepared bacon-tongue mixture, leaving a two-finger width gap between rows
Roll the meat tightly like a barrel and bind firmly with strong twine
Place bacon slices in a long pot, add one or two slices of lean ham, two heads of diced red onion and two carrots
Place the rolled meat on top and fill halfway with strong broth
Cover and braise for several hours, turning frequently and adding small amounts of broth as the sauce reduces
When the meat is completely tender, strain the sauce, remove the twine, and slice with a sharp knife
Arrange the slices on a dish, pour sauce over them, and garnish with small potatoes or mixed vegetables

title: Kifli-pép málnával leöntve (Kifli Paste with Raspberry Sauce)
description: A sauce made with raspberry, ground almonds, and cream.

ingredients.name: 10 dekagramm softened and finely ground almonds
ingredients.sourceText: 10 dekagramm softened and finely ground almonds

steps: Gently grate the crusts of 5 brittle kiflick and cut into slices.
Place in a pan with the almonds, sugar with vanilla, and cream.
Heat over coals, stirring constantly, until smooth paste forms.
Remove from heat and stir in 7 dekagramm butter while still warm, then let cool.
Once completely cold, beat in 6 egg yolks one after another.
Fold in the stiffly beaten whites of 4 eggs.
Butter a pan and line the bottom with white paper, then butter the paper again.
On the bottom of the pan, arrange a wreath of citronade slices, and inside arrange another wreath of preserved sour cherry or medlar pieces the size of a silver coin.
Carefully pour the paste over this and cook in a bain-marie for three-quarters of an hour.
If making the raspberry sauce from cooked fruit, clean it, press through cloth, and cook 4 deciliters of juice with 18 dekagramm sugar until the liquid is slightly thick.
Carefully turn the paste out onto a serving dish, carefully remove the paper lining, and pour the raspberry sauce over the bottom of the dish.

description: A cake made with cream, currants, and almonds.
steps: Pour cream over thin brioche slices and let them soak well
Butter a melon mold
Layer brioche pieces thickly sprinkled with currants
Layer brioche pieces arranged with soaked separated almonds
Layer brioche pieces with raisins
Layer brioche pieces with pistachios, then currants again, continuing until all the mold is filled with layers

Continue layering until the mold is full
Beat together three deciliter cream, ten dekagramm sugar, vanilla, and five egg yolks
Pour this mixture over the top and set in a water bath
Steam continuously for half an hour until the liquid evaporates
Carefully turn out and serve either plain or with cream sauce

title: Kocsonyázott borjúfej (Jellied Calf's Head)
description: Prepared with calf's head, carrots, and onion.
steps: Cut the calf's head in half and cook it in salted water with green parsley, carrots, two heads of red onion, and a little lemon zest until it becomes very tender
Remove it and place it in cold water for a while
Cook the broth in which it was cooked with a little whole pepper and clove pepper and one calf's foot until it reduces to three deciliters
Add the juice of one lemon, strain through a sieve, and set the sauce aside slightly
Remove the bones from the calf's head and cut the meat into long pieces
Place into a mold, strain the sauce once more through clean cloth, pour it over the meat, and place in a cold location until it becomes jelly
Once jellied, turn it out

title: Kocsonyázott csuka vagy kecsege (Jellied Pike or Sterlet)
description: Prepared with pike, vinegar, and onion.
steps: Let the cleaned pike or sterlet lie in salt for an hour.
Pour one part white vinegar and three parts water into a pot, add red onion, fresh parsley, carrot, lemon zest, a few peppercorns, cloves, bay leaf and a little thyme.
Add the fish and two rings of beaten sturgeon bladder and cook until well done but not falling apart.
Then remove and cook the sauce until the sturgeon bladder dissolves.
Stretch a cloth over four legs of an upturned chair, pour the sauce over it and strain slowly so it is clear.
Place the fish on a plate, pour the sauce over it and place in a cold place so it becomes jelly.
Line the back of the fish entirely with aspic.
Hard boil two eggs, remove the yolks and press through a sieve; cut fine slices from the egg white and cut half-moons with a small cutter and decorate the entire fish as desired.

title: Kocsonyázott kompót párolt gyümölcsből (Jellied Compote from Stewed Fruit)
description: Prepared with isinglass, egg white, and apricots.
steps: Beat {{source-0}} well and tear into small pieces
Wash thoroughly in cold water and soak for several hours
Cook in 400-500 ml water until dissolved
Add fresh egg white during cooking, simmer for a few minutes, remove from heat
Let settle and strain the clear part through cloth
Divide into four parts and keep in a warm place
Select 12 finest apricots from a jar and place on a plate
Sprinkle well with crushed sugar and turn several times
Drain juice and sprinkle again so sugar penetrates well
Place remaining apricots with their juice in a bowl
Cook 140 grams sugar with 400 ml water until dissolved
Pour over apricots in bowl and let sit for several hours
Strain without pressing, add juice of a small lemon and one quarter of isinglass
Pass through stretched cloth
Put half in a pan, bury in ice and freeze
Once frozen, layer the sugared apricots on top
Pour remaining aspic over and freeze again
Select the finest pears from a jar and set aside
Place others in a bowl with 100 grams sugar and 200 ml water with half the pears
Once boiling, pour over the pears and let sit
Add juice of 1.5 lemons and another quarter of isinglass, strain through cloth
Pour over apricot layer and arrange pears same way as apricots
Select largest cherries from a jar and set aside on a plate
Sprinkle with sugar and strain
Place remaining cherries in a bowl with 140 grams sugar boiled in 100 ml water
Mix with another quarter of isinglass and strain through cloth
Pour over pear layer and arrange cherries
Select 12 finest autumn apricots on a plate
Sprinkle well with sugar and prepare like the first apricots
Add 1 lemon to the juice and remaining isinglass
Strain through cloth
Once cherry layer is frozen, pour and layer the final aspic
Note: the final aspic must be added slowly and only poured when already frozen to prevent fruit from floating up and mixing with other layers
Keep on ice until serving, use caution and speed when unmolding

Place on ice or in a cellar to freeze

description: Prepared with cream, biscuits, and isinglass.
steps: Line a round flat mold all around and on the bottom with beautiful ladyfingers, with the shiny side of the biscuit facing the mold wall

Whip one liter of good heavy cream into stiff foam

Fill the lined mold with this mixture
Set on finely broken ice

description: Prepared with cream, chocolate, and almond oil.

ingredients.name: Quince paste, cut into small cubes
ingredients.sourceText: Quince paste, cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: One large tablet of Milan chocolate
ingredients.sourceText: One large tablet of Milan chocolate

ingredients.name: Quince paste slices preserved in sugar (alternative)

steps: Line two tin molds very thinly with fresh almond oil
Thickly scatter small cubes of quince paste and green almonds in one of the molds
Set seven deciliters of good heavy cream on crushed ice in a beating pan and whip it with a whisk into stiff foam
Mix in the vanilla sugar and the dissolved and cooled isinglass
Soften one large tablet of Milan chocolate in a pan by placing it in a warm but not hot oven
Quickly beat the softened chocolate with a new wooden spoon
Mix it with half of the cream foam
Pour it into the mold not scattered with fruit, shake well, and cover tightly with the lid
Wrap in parchment paper and set on crushed ice
Mix the pieces of quince paste and almond remaining with the second half of the foam along with any juice that settles from them
Pour this into the scattered mold, cover similarly, wrap, and bury in ice for a few hours
At serving time, remove the molds, wipe clean, dip quickly into hot water, wipe again, unmold onto a very clean board, and cut into slices as thick as a knife blade with a sharp knife
Cover the plate with a cloth and pile the slices high in alternating arrangement

title: Kolbász páczolt hagymával (Sausage with Pickled Onion)
description: Prepared with onions, goose fat, and broth.

ingredients.name: seven to nine white-skinned red onions
ingredients.sourceText: seven to nine white-skinned red onions

steps: Clean the onions and cut them into large pieces.
Heat a few spoonfuls of goose fat and add the onions with salt and pepper.
Braise them slowly over gentle coals until they become golden yellow.
Sprinkle flour over them and braise a little longer with the flour.
Pour a cup of broth over them and cook until the sauce is completely reduced.
Fry five pairs of sausages so that they brown nicely but do not overcook.
Add the sausages to the braised red onions.

title: Kolozsvári Töltött Káposzta (Kolozsvár-Style Stuffed Cabbage)
description: Prepared with cabbage, pork, and beef.

ingredients.name: 3 or 4 heads of fermented head cabbage
ingredients.sourceText: 3 or 4 heads of fermented head cabbage

steps: Use fermented head cabbage, not shaved cabbage, as it has better flavor
Remove the leaves from 3 or 4 heads of fermented cabbage and trim the core from the back of each leaf
Set aside the thinner leaves and chop the remaining leaves thinly
Prepare the filling: finely chop 1/2 kilo pork loin and 1/2 kilo beef brisket
Finely chop 1/4 kilo bacon for larding
Combine the meat and bacon, then add 2 deciliters rice, 1 whole egg, {{source-6}}, and salt to taste
Mix the filling well by hand
Place filling in the reserved thin cabbage leaves, roll, and tuck in the ends
In one roll, wrap about 4 fillér worth of whole peppercorns and tie with string so it doesn't fall apart
In a 7-8 liter earthenware pot, layer 1/4 kilo smoked bacon on the bottom
Add a layer of chopped cabbage
Place on top: 1 pig's ear, 1/2 kilo pork with skin, and 1/2 kilo beef sirloin (these must be boiled first, skimmed, strained through a sieve, and the broth added)
Layer cabbage again, then the cabbage rolls, then cabbage until the pot is full
Pour water to cover the cabbage
If the cabbage is not sour enough, add a small glass of good white wine
Bring to heat and cook until tender, shaking and turning occasionally
When cooked, move to a cold place, covered with a sieve, until the next day
Reheat the next day
For serving: arrange the cabbage on the bottom of the dish, arrange the stuffed cabbage rolls, meat, and bacon on top
Pour the cabbage liquid into a pot, mix with sour cream, bring to a boil, and pour over the arranged cabbage
If cabbage remains in the pot, it can be reheated on the third day

When serving, add bread slices, finely cut pieces from roasted capon and chicken breasts, and veal and mutton

title: Korpa-torta (Bran Cake)
description: A cake made with almonds, egg yolks, and egg white.

ingredients.name: 21 dekagramm almonds, cleaned and ground with skin
ingredients.sourceText: 21 dekagramm almonds, cleaned and ground with skin

steps: Slice the softened almonds, clean the almonds with a cloth and grind with skin
Put in a bowl with ground sugar
Add 2 egg yolks and the stiffly beaten white of 1 egg and stir for a while
Then mix in 2 more egg yolks and the stiffly beaten white of 1 more egg, and continue this way until foamy
Add 2 tablets grated chocolate, the sliced almonds, and 7 dekagramm of lengthwise-cut citron peel
Grease the cake sheet with the hoop together with butter, fill in the mixture and place immediately in the oven so the almonds and citron do not settle
Bake for three-quarters of an hour with gentle but sustained heat
Cover with orange icing and decorate with green fruit

title: Kossuth-Kifli (Kossuth Crescent)
description: Prepared with powdered sugar, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: Beat 25 dekagrams butter and 25 dekagrams powdered sugar with egg yolks until frothy.
Slowly add 25 dekagrams light flour.
Add the stiffly beaten whites of 3 eggs.
Add grated lemon peel.
Pour into a 25 cm square pan, spread with a knife, brush with 1 egg white, sprinkle with chopped almonds, and bake carefully.
Keep it pale, do not brown.
When done, cut into crescent shapes with a pastry cutter.
Place on a sieve and when cooled, arrange on a plate and sprinkle with vanilla sugar.

title: Koszorúk Mandolatejből (Crowns of Almond Milk)
description: Prepared with milk, almonds, and rice.
steps: Bring 7 deciliters of good milk to a boil, place 14 dekagrams of soaked and finely ground almonds in a soup pot, pour hot milk over, and let stand for 15 minutes.
Press through a clean linen cloth.
Prepare 14 dekagrams rice by cleaning it, rubbing well with a cloth, and grinding very finely in a mortar.
Bring the almond milk to a boil, add the rice with enough sugar to taste, and cook to a thick paste with continuous stirring.
Butter 1 or 2 sheet cakes and spread the hot paste with a wide knife dipped in milk to the thickness of a small finger.
Cool, then dust a board with flour and sugar, warm the cake slightly on the bottom, and unmold the rice.
Cut out circles with a medium donut cutter, then cut the center of each ring with a smaller cutter to form a crown.
Brush with beaten eggs, coat with fine breadcrumbs, and fry in fat to a bread-brown color.
When removed from fat, sprinkle thickly with sugar.
Arrange on a plate covered with a kitchen cloth in three rows in a cross pattern, placing a preserved cherry in the opening of each crown and serve hot.

steps: Line beautiful egg-shaped cake molds with shortcrust pastry
Fill with gold leaf paper shaped into a ball like the mold shape
Bake until golden brown in the oven
Meanwhile, prepare cream custard by mixing cream, egg yolks, sugar, and vanilla in a pot, stirring constantly over moderate heat until thickened
Set aside
When cakes are baked, remove the paper ball
Place 4 to 6 cherries in each cake that have been cooked in sugar and drained well
Fill the cakes with the cream custard
Return to the oven until the custard hardens
When serving, turn out onto a plate, sprinkle with vanilla sugar, and arrange on a platter so the cakes resemble bowls filled with cream custard

steps: From cooked veal innards remove the larynx, spleen and membrane
Chop the rest finely with parsley and milk-soaked bread
Melt seven dekagrams of butter
Add a handful of breadcrumbs and fry until golden
Add the chopped mixture with salt, mace and a little pepper
Braise slightly
Beat in one whole egg and three egg yolks
Quickly stir and remove from heat
Continue stirring until eggs are well combined
Prepare a crumbly dough for the mushroom stems
Roll out to the thickness of a knife back
Cut into cubes two finger widths wide
Roll these onto the wooden spoon handle
Brush slightly with egg white to hold together
Shape mushroom caps from the chopped mixture above the stems
Roll in beaten egg and then breadcrumbs
Fry in lard
Place in soup bowl and pour brown broth over them

title: Kásás Bélés (Millet-Filled Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with lard, egg yolks, and flour.

ingredients.name: one and a half kilograms flour

ingredients.name: millet porridge cooked with pepper and plenty of lard, cooled
ingredients.sourceText: millet porridge cooked with pepper and plenty of lard, cooled

steps: Prepare a pastry dough with flour, lard, egg yolks, and salt water (or milk can be used instead of water for a less crusty dough)
Knead well until smooth, then stretch it out and let it rest
After resting, stretch it out on the table and brush with hot lard, then stretch all the remaining dough layers on top of each other
Divide into four parts and fold the parts on top of each other, then cut the resulting thick dough into ten-centimeter square pieces

Fill each square with a walnut-sized piece of cooled millet porridge, gather all four edges of the dough together to form small rounded filled pastries, pressing them slightly flat so the porridge spreads inside
Bake in a hot oven until beautifully golden—they should bake quickly and rise well

title: Kávé-hab (Coffee Foam)
description: Prepared with coffee, cream, and isinglass.
steps: Brew very strong coffee and filter it through fine cloth when completely clear
Add sugar generously and set on ice
Whip 1 liter of excellent heavy cream in a basin on ice until it becomes foam
Add sifted sugar to the basin, add 2 tablespoons of strong black coffee, and beat together
Gradually add the whipped cream
If the foam is too white, add more coffee so it becomes dark yellow with prominent coffee flavor
Finally, fold in the dissolved, cooled, and strained isinglass
Pour into a mold and set on ice
Before serving, turn out onto a plate and arrange neatly with Spanish doughnuts

title: Kávé-pép (Coffee Paste)
description: Prepared with coffee, cream, and egg yolks.
steps: Roast the coffee well and place it hot into 7 deciiliters of hot cream
Cover well and let stand for half an hour so the cream absorbs the coffee aroma
Place 3 large cooking spoonfuls of flour in a pot, strain the cream through fine sieve onto the flour and mix well
Place on coals and stir until it begins to boil
Cook for a few more minutes and then cool
Beat 10 dekagrams of butter until foamy
Mix in the cooled paste and stir well with 8 egg yolks
Add powdered sugar to taste
Stir for another half hour
Gently fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites
Place the paste in a buttered torte wrapper and bake for half an hour
Remove the ring, sprinkle with finely powdered sugar and serve quickly to the table

title: Kávé-torta (Coffee Cake)
description: A cake made with coffee, cornstarch, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: 28 dekagrams sugar rubbed lightly with lemon
ingredients.sourceText: 28 dekagrams sugar rubbed lightly with lemon

ingredients.name: strong coffee of the best quality
ingredients.sourceText: 1 cup strong coffee of the best quality

steps: Pound the sugar rubbed with lemon and sift it; similarly pound and sift the cornstarch
In a bowl, beat the sugar with 14 egg yolks for a good quarter hour until it becomes beautifully white and begins to rise
Beat 10 egg whites into stiff snow
First add the cornstarch flour and stir it in gently, then the egg snow, which must be mixed in very quickly
Grease a rimmed ring mold well with butter without any decorations; dust it lightly with fine flour
Similarly grease a baking sheet with butter

Fill the ring mold with the sponge batter so that it remains empty to a width of two fingers; spread the remaining batter on the baking sheet smoothly and evenly to the thickness of a knife blade with a wide knife
Bake both in a warm oven or stove at gentle heat until golden brown like a bread roll

Quickly remove the sheet and with a sharp knife cut out two round layers that fit exactly on the ring mold; place them back in the oven for a few moments, then turn out the ring, remove the layers from the sheet with a knife, place both on paper and keep near the warm oven
Pound 35 dekagrams sugar finely and sift it; brew a cup-full of strong, best quality coffee and set this, as well as 4 deciliters whipped cream, on ice

Place the sponge ring exactly on one of the layers; from the sugar and coffee, which you stir in only spoonful by spoonful, prepare a light ice, but it must not be liquid; cover the entire ring and the second layer, which you keep as a lid, with this
Once the ice has dried (which goes very easily on an economical stove, as you place the cake on a sieve near it), whip stiff snow from the chilled cream with a whisk, placing the whisk bowl on ice
Once this is done, put in 28 dekagrams sugar and as much ice-chilled coffee until the snow takes on a yellowish color and the coffee flavor becomes predominant

Mix the sugar and coffee well with the snow using the whisk, and fill the entire opening of the ring with this snow, which must already have dried; quickly place the lid on top, quickly cover the strip on the lid with the remaining ice, cut neat paper for the cake base, place the cake on it on a table covered with a tablecloth and quickly serve it to the table
The coffee snow must be filled into the ring only at the moment when the cake is served to the table, so that the ring does not soften
It can also be served without a lid, in which case the snow is filled into the ring and piled high at the moment it is served to the table

If the cake is prepared in a season when fresh strawberries can be obtained, the sponge ring can also be covered with strawberry pulp; pass the red strawberries through a fine sieve, place sifted sugar in a bowl, and mix the strawberry spoonful by spoonful with this; if it had a very pale color, one or two drops of cochineal can be mixed in; use care with the addition of strawberry syrup, so that it is not too thin

Cover the ring as with the coffee and let it dry; mix the strained strawberry in the bowl with finely pounded sugar for the snow, keep the cream snow on ice, and stir in the strawberry only slowly with the whisk and whip it up slightly again
Only so much may be added that the strawberry is still recognizable, so that the mixture is not too thin; give it color with cochineal
This cake can also be served without a lid, except that the snow is then filled and piled up at the moment of serving on the tablecloth

title: Kávés Lepény (Coffee Cake)
description: A cake made with coffee, egg yolks, and egg yolk.
steps: On a board, work the flour with the soft butter in layers
Mix finely ground sugar with flour
Add three hard-boiled egg yolks
Work everything well with the roller
Gather the mixture together and add one egg yolk, work well with knife
Roll out the smooth dough to three knife-widths thickness
Place on buttered sheet
Bake slowly at low heat
When baked and cooled, cut into two-finger wide and span-long strips
Coat the strips with jam
Cook ten dekagrams sugar with half cup black coffee until it begins to thread
When cooled, beat three egg whites to stiff snow
With the whisk, mix in seven dekagrams ground sugar
Add the cooked coffee
Spread the whole mixture smoothly on the strips
Dry in cooled oven
When dried, pile high on a cloth-covered plate

ingredients.sourceText: one quarter lamb from the front

steps: Put one quarter lamb with various vegetables in two liters of salted water to cook

Serve in deep bowls

title: Lehámozott szilva eczetben (Peeled Plums in Vinegar)
description: Prepared with plums, sugar, and cinnamon.
steps: Peel the plums either with a knife or by holding them in a strainer of hot water until the skin can be pulled off.
Once all are peeled, place in clean earthenware or glass jars.
For 2 kilograms plums, cook 6 deciliters vinegar with 60 dekagrams sugar, whole cinnamon, and cloves.
Skim it clean and pour cold over the plums.
Place the jars or crocks filled with plums into a vessel filled with cold water.

title: Lengyel-rostélyos (Polish Sirloin)
description: Prepared with fat, onions, and peppercorns.
steps: Cut slices from lean loin, beat them well with a mallet, and salt them
Place one spoon cold fat in a pot with a layer of meat

Serve with its own fat and macaroni on the side

title: Leveles tészta (Layered Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with lemon, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: Rub the sugar on a large lemon, finely grind the sugar
Whip the butter until foamy and add egg yolks one by one
Once the eggs are well beaten, add the sugar and beat for a quarter hour
Add the fine flour and the stiffly beaten egg whites
Butter three torte sheets with rings
Divide the batter into three equal parts on the torte sheets
Bake until a beautiful light yellow color
When baked and cooled, one sheet remains on the torte sheets, two are set aside on a sieve
Fill each sheet with preserved fruit and leave the top one empty
A quarter hour before serving, beat stiffly the egg whites of five eggs with two tablespoons peach marmalade and {{source-11}}
Gradually fold in the egg whites and coat the top and sides of the pastry with a knife
Fill the remaining meringue into a Spanish pastry bag and pipe hazelnut-sized meringues in three rows around the edge of the top sheet
Place a large button in the center of the sheet, surround it with smaller meringues so they touch the button, keeping them small but beautifully tall, which requires a light and steady hand
Sprinkle with fine sugar and place in a cool oven or cold cooled oven so the meringue retains its color and does not harden too much

title: Leveles-tészta más módon (Puff Pastry Another Way)
description: A pastry dish made with egg yolks, egg whites, and almonds.

ingredients.name: 14 dekagramms finely ground and sifted sugar (for topping)
ingredients.sourceText: 14 dekagramms finely ground and sifted sugar (for topping)

steps: Melt the butter and quickly stir in the flour, then cook with warm milk while continuously stirring until well cooked and a smooth thick paste forms
Cool and add sugar to taste and a little vanilla
Slowly fold in the egg yolks and the stiff peaks of 4 egg whites
Grease round copper pans lined with lead with a two-finger-wide rim
Fill with the paste to finger thickness
Bake at gentle heat
When well baked, turn out onto a clean board
Cut out 5-6 leaves with a medium-sized cutter
Place the first leaf on a plate, spread with preserves, add the second leaf and cover again with preserves, continuing until all leaves are stacked and filled
Mix 14 dekagramms finely ground and sifted sugar with stiff peaks of 3 egg whites and a little vanilla
Coat the entire pastry smoothly with this
Fill a Spanish pastry bag with the remainder and pipe small Spanish pastries the size of hazelnuts on the pastry in neat rows
Prepare 4 dekagramms softened almonds, dry well with a cloth and chop finely
Mix with the same amount of finely ground sugar
Sprinkle the entire pastry with this
Bake in a hot oven or a light golden yellow color

steps: Wash the veal brains thoroughly and cook in salted water

Form small dumplings and cook in good beef broth
Place in soup bowl and pour brown or white broth over them

title: Leves Agyvelő-Kádkákkal (Soup with Brains in Molds)
description: A soup made with bread, egg whites, and bread crumbs.
steps: Rasp off the crust of two bread rolls, soften them in milk, and squeeze dry.
Place in a pot, pour four deciliters milk over them, bring to a boil over coals with continuous stirring until reduced to a puree.
Remove from heat and let cool.
Beat seven decagrams butter until fluffy.
Add a little salt, one whole egg, and the foam of three egg whites.
Place a little of the forcemeat in molds greased with butter and sprinkled with fine bread crumbs.
Fill the center with prepared brains and cover with the remaining forcemeat without completely filling.
The brains must first be cooked in salted water, then blanched, and braised with butter, finely chopped green parsley.
Cook the molds in steam for half an hour.
Unmold, place in a bowl, and pour brown sauce over it.

title: Leves Agyvelő-Pitével (Soup with Brain Pâté)
description: A soup made with bread, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: Rasp off the crust of two bread rolls, cut into thin slices, place in a pot.
Pour four deciliters milk over them and let soften for an hour.
Place on coals and cook with continuous stirring until it becomes a puree.
Remove from heat and let cool.
Mix the cooled puree with prepared brains and ten decagrams butter beaten until fluffy.
Mix in eight egg yolks well beaten.
Gently fold in the foam of three egg whites.
Fill the forcemeat into a mold greased with butter and sprinkled with fine crumbs.
Cook by steaming for three-quarters of an hour.
Carefully unmold onto a clean board and cut into finger-thick slices.
Place in a soup bowl and pour brown sauce over it.
The brains must be cooked in salted water, placed in cold water, the membrane removed, finely chopped, and braised with butter, green parsley, a little pepper, and salt as needed before use.

description: A soup made with veal, capon, and bread crumbs.
steps: Chop roasted veal, capon breast, and turkey breast finely, soak a roll in milk and squeeze it out, beat 3 eggs, and chop green parsley finely.

title: Leves consommé-kádkákkal (Soup with Consommé Dumplings)
description: A soup made with consommé, chickens, and veal.
steps: Chop 2 well-roasted chickens and a piece of roasted veal and pound finely in a mortar.
Pour 1 liter of strong chicken broth over it, pass through a sieve, mix together with 9 egg yolks, and pass through the sieve again.
Grease the dumplings with butter and fill with consommé and braise.
When the consommé sets, turn it out onto a soup dish and pour light brown broth over it.

To braise: Pour enough water into a deep pot so it reaches halfway up the mold; when the water boils, place the mold in it, cover with an iron lid, and place on the hot plate of the stove with as much heat as required.

For larger quantities of such a dish, it often must be cooked longer than an hour in this water, so if the water evaporates, it must be replaced with hot water, but the mentioned level must never be exceeded, as the contents would be in danger of the water overflowing it.

Place in steam for half an hour
Turn out into a soup bowl and pour good brown broth over it

Cook in good beef broth all at once

description: A soup made with veal, onion, and puff pastry.
steps: Cook veal lung and heart until tender
Remove the pharynx and chop the rest finely
Melt a piece of butter
Add finely chopped parsley and a little red onion
Sauté slightly
Add the chopped lung with a little salt
Fry briefly and stir well
Add two well-beaten eggs and remove from heat
Let cool
Prepare common puff pastry dough and roll out finely
Fill with the lung mixture leaving one and a half arm-lengths empty
Cut this empty part in half down the middle
Roll the dough from all sides so the empty dough covers the filled part several times
Press with a wooden spoon handle dipped in flour to make small indentations
Cut in half with a knife
Press the ends together
Cook the pockets in white broth
Place in bowl and pour brown broth over them

title: Leves zsemlekádkákkal (Soup with Bread Molds)
description: A soup made with rolls, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: Remove crusts from 2 rolls, cut into slices
Pour 4 deciliters of milk over them and cook to a fine paste with continuous stirring
Remove from heat and let cool completely after mixing in 8 dekagrams butter
Beat in 1 whole egg and 4 egg yolks one after another
Season slightly with salt
Finally gently fold in 3 stiffly beaten egg whites
Butter the molds, put a spoonful of paste in each, add a teaspoon of filling or ground meat on top
Cover with another spoonful of paste and bake nicely
Note: the bread paste must not be thin, otherwise the filling will sink to the bottom; generally the molds must be filled quickly and immediately placed in the water bath

title: Levestáblácskák utazásra (Portable Soup Tablets for Travel)
description: A soup made with meat, hen, and veal.

ingredients.name: lean meat from the loin
ingredients.sourceText: 2.5 kilograms lean meat from the loin

steps: Cook {{source-0}} with 2.5 kilograms lean meat, {{source-2}}, an old hen, and two veal feet until completely tender
In a large pot, layer sliced onions, veal shank, veal knuckles, lean pork, and mutton
Pour 4 deciliters water over it and add carrots, parsley, and parsnip root
Braise until the liquid is brown at the bottom
Pour the cooked meat broth over it and simmer slowly for 3-4 hours to keep the broth clear
When everything is very soft and the meat nearly inedible, strain through a fine sieve, then through cheesecloth, and transfer to another pot
Slowly reduce until it resembles a meat glaze (glace), from about 6 liters down to 2 liters
Strain through clean cheesecloth and pour onto a flat dish to cool
Once completely cooled and set, cut into pieces the size of chocolate tablets and lay on paper in a cool, airy place to dry
When completely dry, store in a dry place for later use
Note: if dissolving a tablet in hot water while traveling to quickly make broth, do not salt it further as it would become sour

description: A bread preparation made with egg yolks, egg whites, and blanched almonds.
steps: Place egg yolks in a bowl, whip the egg whites into stiff peaks
Finely crush the sugar and beat it together with the peaks and egg yolks using a whisk for a good hour until thick
In a pan, toast the blanched and finely chopped almonds until golden
Once cooled, mix into the beaten mixture
Add the finely chopped lemon zest and flour and mix everything well
Fill the dough into a buttered twice-baked bread form and bake slowly
Once baked and cooled, either slice like twice-baked bread or cut into small pieces

title: Linczi torta tojás nélkül (Linz Cake without Eggs)
description: A cake made with almonds, lemon, and sugar.
steps: Pound the softened almonds finely, moistening with water during pounding so that it does not become oily
Pound the same amount of sugar with vanilla finely and chop the zest of one lemon into small pieces
Beat 28 dekagrams butter until foamy, mixing in a spoonful of cold water during the beating, as well as the juice of one lemon, the almonds, and the sugar
Once well beaten into a foamy state, gently mix in 28 dekagrams flour

From this, prepare either a rod cake or a soup cake; in the first case, fill it with preserves, cover nicely with the rod, place the ring on top, coat with egg white, dust with coarsely pounded sugar, and then bake at sustained heat
This dough can also be used for small pastries, such as small cakes, pretzels, etc.

title: Lúdmáj rizs-abroncsban (Goose Liver in Rice Ring)
description: Prepared with goose liver, rice, and onion.
steps: Wash and salt the goose liver and place it in a pot
Place 9-10 slices of red onion and sliced carrots under the liver
Pierce the liver with cloves
Pour 2 deciliters of sour cream over it
Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and small pieces of butter
Roast for one hour
Remove the liver, clean it of sauce and fat
Pour a few spoonfuls of stock over the remaining vegetables and quickly reduce
Place the liver in a dish where the rice ring should already be prepared and pour the small amount of sauce over it
For the rice ring: melt a small piece of butter and add finely chopped parsley
Add 14 decagrams of cleaned rice to the butter
Add the Spanish onion quartered
Slowly braise the rice, occasionally pouring small amounts of stock so it does not break
When softened, remove the onion and add pepper and crayfish butter
In another pot, melt butter and add finely chopped parsley with several finely chopped mushrooms
Braise with a little black pepper until the sauce has evaporated
Sprinkle a little flour over it
Pour in one or two spoonfuls of sour cream and let it evaporate again
Form a rice ring in the dish and fill it with the braised mushrooms and crayfish tails
Leave two finger-widths of space between them so the whole resembles a ribbon
Place the goose liver in the middle

title: Lúdmáj Írósvaj-mártással (Goose Liver with Butter Sauce)
description: A sauce made with goose, butter, and egg yolks.
steps: Clean two goose livers well and cut into beautiful slices
Place half on a buttered baking sheet, salt, and flavor with crushed clove
Mix two egg yolks with sour sour cream and lemon-sugar, pour over the liver and bake in the oven
Flour the other half of the liver, dip in beaten egg then bread crumbs, fry in butter, and constantly baste with broth
Finally, melt butter with hot sour cream and sugar for the sauce, and pour over the baked liver when this sauce is ready

title: Lúdmáj-szálmi (Goose Liver Fricassee)
description: Prepared with goose, bacon, and onions.

ingredients.name: one or two beautiful goose livers
ingredients.sourceText: one or two beautiful goose livers

steps: Wash the goose livers and salt them, mixing pepper into the salt
Stud each liver with three or four cloves
Place thin bacon slices and two heads of onion cut into slices in a pot
Place the livers on top and cover with a few more thin bacon slices
Put live coals on the pot lid and braise slowly
When nicely golden, remove the livers and sprinkle a small spoonful of flour into the pot, allowing it to brown
Thin with a good ladle of beef broth and cook well
Remove the cloves from the livers and cut away all edge pieces from the liver
Cut thick slices from the center of the liver and arrange on the dish rim, keeping warm
When the sauce is well reduced, strain it
Press the onion, bacon, and liver remnants through a sieve into a small pot
Thin with one or two spoonfuls of sauce and cook well until it becomes a thick paste
Spread this paste on the bottom of the dish
Arrange the liver slices in a crown around the fricassee
Pour a few spoonfuls of sauce over the liver and serve hot

title: Magyar fogas (Hungarian Pike-perch)
description: Prepared with pike, vinegar, and egg yolks.
steps: After the fish has lain on ice for several days, clean it
Split it open and rinse well
Salt it thoroughly
Tie the fins with string and let it rest
One hour before serving, tie it in a special fish cloth
Place in hot salted water flavored with a few drops of dill vinegar and cook
Make a fine butter sauce with the fish broth, add nutmeg, and bring to a boil
Beat five egg yolks with one lemon together, combine with the butter sauce like a roux, and pour into a sauce cup
Place the fish on a cloth-covered board, then in an oblong dish
Remove the string and arrange on the table garnished with green parsley and served with sauce

title: Makaroni (Pasta Mold)
description: Prepared with pasta, broth, and ham.
steps: Cook the pasta in white broth.
Melt 25 dekagrams of butter, add {{source-3}} and let it simmer slightly.
Increase with 3 tablespoons of sweet milk and remove from heat.
When cooled, beat in 4 whole eggs.
Add the cooked pasta and shake well.
Grease a mold with butter and pour in half the pasta.
Sprinkle a layer of finely chopped ham and finely grated cheese.
Add another layer of pasta and repeat three times until the mold is full.
Boil the mold in hot water for 1.5 hours, then serve.
Optional sauce: Stick cloves into an onion head and fry in a little fat, add 2 tablespoons flour, fill with good meat broth, strain through a sieve, and add sautéed button mushrooms.

title: Malacz vagdalékkal töltve (Suckling Pig Stuffed with Forcemeat)
description: Prepared with suckling pig, veal, and marrow.
steps: Clean the pig thoroughly, cut off the head and legs, and slit the belly lengthwise.
Separate the meat and bones from the skin carefully with a sharp knife without damaging the skin.
Chop finely 28 dekagrams each of veal shoulder, 14 dekagrams of marrow, and bread roll soaked in milk.
Pound this mixture in a mortar, pour four whole eggs over it, pound again, add salt, little crushed black pepper, and nutmeg flowers.
Pass through a fine sieve and spread the mixture inside the pig to the thickness of a thumb.
Cut cooked, pickled or smoked tongue into pieces the size of a small finger, and similarly cut pickled cucumber.
Arrange these in strips over the forcemeat, leaving spaces the width of a finger between them.
Roll up like a strudel, wrap in clean cloth, and tie both ends securely.
Place in a long pot with sliced red onion, carrot, a few peppercorns and allspice, and the cut-off head and legs.
Pour two liters of white wine and four deciliters of vinegar over it, salt it, cover, and cook until the head is tender.
Cool it, and when it has cooled and set, pour the cooking liquid over it and set aside until ready to use.
Before serving, remove from the cloth, dry it clean, and slice thinly.

title: Malaczot Sütni (Roast Suckling Pig)
description: Prepared with suckling pig, lard, and salt.
steps: After killing and scalding the pig, use water that is not too hot—only hot enough that you can safely insert your finger into it.
Remove the entrails and clean the pig thoroughly.
Salt it well and coat the interior with ground pepper.
Splay the thighs apart; bend the front legs inward at the joints so they lie backward and tie them with twine to maintain their natural position.
Thread the pig lengthwise onto a spit so that the spit passes through the neck and comes out through the nose without making a hole.
Stuff clean cloth into the mouth and sew it closed.
Roast for one hour over medium heat or in the oven, frequently basting with a piece of lard, then wiping clean with cloth after a few moments, and turning frequently to prevent blistering.
The skin should turn a beautiful golden-brown and be crispy and brittle.
When done, remove the spit, cloth, and twine, and quickly bring to the table.

steps: Cut the 3-4 week old piglet into small pieces and keep in a bowl filled with water
For each kilo of meat, render 3-4 deka fresh bacon cut into small cubes until the cracklings turn bread-yellow
Add 1-2 teaspoons of black ground pepper per kilo of meat to the fresh hot fat with the cracklings still in it
Immediately take the piglet meat from the water and place it in the fat so the pepper does not burn
Cover the casserole and let the meat braise
After half an hour, if the meat has absorbed the rendered liquid, pour in fat-free meat broth so the meat is always submerged about a quarter of its height

At this time, salt the meat and simultaneously add for each kilo of meat as much finely chopped green parsley as can be held with five fingers, and 1/2 small clove of garlic per kilo, finely chopped or ground in a wooden mortar
Continue braising until the meat is completely tender, occasionally pouring in broth
When the meat is done braising, taste the broth and add more salt if needed

Before serving, for 3-4 kilos of meat add 1/2 teaspoon good paprika and a little marjoram, then let the whole thing braise briefly without a cover until it reduces by half, and serve in a warm bowl and on heated plates

title: Maláta-eczet (Malt Vinegar)
description: Prepared with barley, yeast, and water.
steps: Soak 15 liters of barley in water.
When it swells, pour it onto a floor, cover it with something light until it begins to sprout, then spread it out, dry it again, and grind it coarsely.
Soak the ground malt in lukewarm water for several hours, then heat it well in hot water, then boil it for one hour.
For this amount of malt, calculate 40 liters of water.

After boiling, filter the liquid through a clean sack or sieve, at the bottom of which you have placed straw, into a container, and when it is half as warm as fresh milk, place it in a small barrel or trough, mix it with 7 deciliters of yeast, then cover and let it stand in a warm place.

Fermentation will soon begin, and when it no longer rises and no bubbling can be observed, and you have removed the yeast on top, draw off the fermented liquid through a tap, which is applied 3-5 centimeters above the bottom of the barrel, so that only clear vinegar flows out without the yeast and other cloudy parts.
The barrel into which you draw it off should first be rinsed with vinegar.

title: Mandola-lepény habarva (Almond Cake Mixed)
description: A cake made with puff pastry, almonds, and lemon.
steps: Prepare crumbly puff pastry and tear off twenty small pieces
Cover with warm cloth and let rise half an hour
Butter the plate needed
Stretch the pastry very finely, brushing each layer with melted butter; stretch out six layers
For the seventh layer prepare the filling: soften twenty-one dekagrams almonds (some of which should be bitter) and grind finely
Put the same amount of fine broken sugar and finely chopped zest of one lemon in the bowl
Mix in seven whole eggs and four egg yolks one by one and beat until foamy
Spread half this filling on the seventh layer of pastry
Then stretch six more layers on top, brush each with melted butter
Spread the other half of the filling on top
Finally stretch the remaining pastry on top
Cut off the pastry hanging over the edge, brush the top with butter, and bake slowly until the pastry is beautiful golden yellow and crispy

title: Mandola-pép friss megggyel (Almond Paste with Fresh Cherries)
description: Prepared with cherries, almonds, and lemon.

ingredients.name: zest of half a lemon, finely chopped
ingredients.sourceText: zest of half a lemon, finely chopped

ingredients.name: fresh ripe cherries, with stems removed
ingredients.sourceText: fresh ripe cherries, with stems removed

steps: Soften the almonds and crush the sugar, then sift the sugar
Chop the lemon zest finely and place everything in a bowl
Beat in the whole egg and six egg yolks one after another
Stir the mixture for half an hour
Wash the ripe cherries, remove the stems, and lightly poach them with sugar so they remain whole
Butter a mold and line it with paper, then butter the paper again
Arrange the cherries neatly on the bottom of the mold
Spread half the almond paste on top and set in a water bath
After five to ten minutes, when the paste has firmed and the cherries have not sunk, arrange the remaining cherries on top
Pour the remaining almond paste over them
Work quickly without removing the mold from the water bath
Cover immediately and poach whole for one hour

Pour onto a buttered torta leaf and bake evenly.
