title: Mandola-pép töltött almával (Almond Paste with Stuffed Apple)
description: Prepared with almonds, raisins, and lemon.
steps: Finely grind 17 dekagramm softened almonds and 17 dekagramm sugar.
Place in a bowl with 5 dekagramm raisins and finely chopped zest of 1 lemon.
Beat with 2 whole eggs and 4 egg yolks for half an hour.
Fold in the stiffly beaten whites of 4 eggs.
Peel 8-10 large apples, hollow them out, and parboil them briefly in water.
Place the apples in a porcelain dish that will also be used for serving.
Fill the apples with preserves as desired, sprinkle with sugar.
Pour the paste over the apples and place in the oven.
Once baked, prepare a meringue from the whites of 2 eggs and apricot.
Arrange the meringue around the edge of the dish, heap high in a crown with a wide knife.
Make incisions with a demitasse spoon about two fingers wide apart to resemble a plaited crown.
Return to the oven and bake for another half hour.

title: Mandolaleves (Almond Soup)
description: A soup made with ground almonds, egg yolks, and milk.

ingredients.name: twelve dekagrams swollen finely ground almonds
ingredients.sourceText: twelve dekagrams swollen finely ground almonds

steps: Heat seven deciliters of sweet milk with fourteen dekagrams of sugar and a little vanilla.
Add twelve dekagrams of swollen finely ground almonds.
Bring to a boil once.
Before serving, beat four egg yolks in a pot and mix them with hot milk.
Place toasted breadcrumb slices in the soup tureen and pour half the soup over them.
Whip the other half of the soup until frothy and pour it over the bread slices in the tureen until it is full of foam.
Then pour the rest of the soup into the tureen gradually, which should be placed over a bed of coals.

description: Prepared with beef, kidney, and bacon.

ingredients.name: beef from the chuck
ingredients.sourceText: three kilograms beef from the chuck

ingredients.name: carrots (one and a half centimeter pieces)

steps: Clean the kidney roast beef of all connective tissue from the wider part
Pierce it in 3-4 rows, season with salt
Prepare for braising as previously described, ensuring the bacon remains whole and the beef roasts to a nice brown
Before serving, completely coat the beef in a small amount of sauce that should be glace-like consistency, then slice
Similarly cook three kilograms of chuck beef

Serve the beef surrounded by a crown of garnishes: green peas (boiled in salted water, mixed with finely chopped parsley, a little broth, and crushed sugar in hot butter, then shaken well and braised slightly to maintain their green color)
Prepare sour cabbage braised to a nice brown-yellow as described in the book
Cook macaroni in salted water, toss in fresh hot butter, sprinkle generously with lean finely chopped ham
Prepare carrots by cutting into one and a half centimeter pieces, shaping the bottom point finely and the top proportionally into a head

Melt half an egg-sized piece of butter, stir in a spoon of crushed sugar, brown to golden yellow, pour in a spoonful of white broth, add the carrots, season lightly with salt, shake several times until they become completely soft but remain whole
Before serving, cut the white-cooked meat and kidney roast beef into uniform pieces, arrange on a long platter in cross pattern so one row is white meat and the next is brown meat
Arrange the crown of garnishes around the meat (green peas, braised cabbage, macaroni with ham, carrots) in high, evenly wide strips

title: Marhahús-szeletek (Beefsteak)
description: Prepared with potatoes, beef, and onions.
steps: Wash 7-8 large yellow potatoes, peel and slice them
Cook until completely soft in salted water
Drain and mix with 7 decagrams of butter
Press through a fine sieve and keep warm
Cut thin, round slices from well-beaten and cleaned beef
Salt them and mix in 3 medium red onions, a handful of chopped green parsley and a knife-point of crushed black pepper
Place several spoonfuls of fat in a flat pot and place the slices with the mixture in it
Braise until the slices are cooked; the red onion and parsley should not break apart but only become light yellow
At serving time, place the potato purée at the bottom of the dish and heap it in the middle
Coat the slices thickly with the braised red onion and parsley, first straining off the fat and mixing it into the purée
Arrange the slices nicely around the edge of the dish so they form a crown

Place the tongue back in it, turn on all sides and the dish is ready.
Place braised small red onions around the edge of the plate.

title: Marrow Dough (Velős tészta)
description: Prepared with melted butter, egg yolks, and egg whites.
steps: Roast the flour in the melted butter
Slowly pour in the hot milk while continuously stirring and cook until it becomes a smooth paste
Remove from heat and cool
Slowly mix in 6 egg yolks, season lightly with salt
Mix in the stiff snow from 3 egg whites
Grease a large flat baking dish or plate with a two-finger wide rim with butter
Place one third of the paste in it and bake
Meanwhile, scald the calf brain in salted water, clean it and cut into small slices
Braise with finely chopped red onion and fresh parsley, season with a little salt and pepper
Grease a baking dish with butter
Divide the baked paste into three equal slices
Place the first slice in the dish and fill it with the prepared brains
Add the second slice and fill again, then add the third slice and fill that as well
Finally cover with the remaining unbaked dough
Cook in a water bath for a good half hour
Turn out onto a platter and serve quickly

For a sweet version, place fresh and heavily sugared fruit such as apricots between the baked layers instead of brains, and sprinkle with sugar when baked; do not salt the paste but mix in vanilla sugar instead

title: Masszedoán (Macedoine Jelly)
description: Prepared with lemon, juice, and isinglass.

ingredients.name: four and one-half dekagrams dissolved isinglass
ingredients.sourceText: four and one-half dekagrams dissolved isinglass

ingredients.name: beautiful, large preserved fruit in sugar
ingredients.sourceText: beautiful, large preserved fruit in sugar

steps: Mix seven lemon juices with eight deciliters of water
In this mixture, dissolve thirty-five dekagrams of crushed sugar that has been rubbed on two lemons
Mix in four and one-half dekagrams of dissolved isinglass
Strain through a taut cloth until clear
Pour into a mold to a height of two centimeters and place on ice until it freezes
Arrange a dense wreath of green, thinly sliced almonds and beautiful, large sugar-preserved fruit around the edge of the mold
Arrange two rows of leaves, one row with tips pointing down and the other pointing up, with the fruit in the middle connecting with the leaves
Arrange a star in the same manner in the center of the mold
Pour a coffee-cup-sized amount of jelly on top
When this sets enough to hold the fruit in place, pour another layer of jelly so that jelly covers one-third of it
Layer in sliced quince or quince paste as previously described
For each new layer of fruit, initially pour only a small amount of jelly so the fruit does not rise, first securing it with little jelly, then pouring more on top
The third layer of jelly should be filled with whole or half sugar-cooked apricots, pour similarly small amounts of jelly on these until they freeze
Finally add the remaining jelly
Keep on ice until use and unmold as with the others

title: Meggy mézbe berakva (Black Cherries Preserved in Honey)
description: Prepared with cherries, honey, and cinnamon.

ingredients.name: larger black cherries with stems removed
ingredients.sourceText: larger black cherries with stems removed

steps: Prepare a barrel slightly smaller than one used for cucumbers.
Wash and dry large black cherries after removing their stems.
For a 4.25 liter barrel, crush 3 dekagrams cinnamon and 1 dekagram cloves.
Divide the spices equally among three small bags made from clean linen and sew them closed.
Place one spice bag on the bottom of the barrel.
Cook 2 liters of good white honey, skim it clean, and let it cool.
Pour some of the cooled liquid honey on the barrel bottom and place some cherries on top.
Add another spice bag on the cherries, then the remaining cherries, and place the third spice bag and remaining honey on top.
Leave two finger-widths of space at the top of the barrel.
Place clean linen on the bung, drive it in firmly, and store in a cool place.

ingredients.sourceText: beautiful ripe sour cherries with stems removed

steps: Wash ripe cherries and crush in a mortar with their pits
Extract the juice
Use 7 deciliters of cherry juice with the strained juice of 2 lemons
Cook 42 dekagrams of sugar with 2 deciliters of water until it forms heavy drops
Mix the cooked sugar with the cherry juice
Add 4.5 dekagrams of dissolved isinglass
Strain through cloth and blotting paper
Pour into mold and freeze

title: Meggy-kádka (Sour Cherry Custard Cake)
description: A cake made with almond, egg yolks, and egg whites.

ingredients.name: 7 dekagrams soaked and finely ground almond
ingredients.sourceText: 7 dekagrams soaked and finely ground almond

steps: Stir together for one hour: 14 dekagrams of sifted sugar, 7 dekagrams of soaked and finely ground almond, 4 whole eggs, 4 egg yolks, and 4 egg whites beaten stiffly
Finally add the finely chopped zest of 1 lemon and 7 dekagrams of breadcrumb (kifli)
Mix this well with the rest
Fill a buttered mold (kádka) with this mixture
Place 5 sour cherries in each one
Bake at gentle heat

title: Meggy-leves (Sour Cherry Soup)
description: A soup made with cherries, wine, and bread.
steps: Put the sour cherries in a pot with a small amount of wine and braise until reduced to a paste

Flavor with broken cinnamon, sugar, and a small amount of lemon peel
Bring to a boil and serve into toasted bread points

title: Meggy-rétes (Sour Cherry Strudel)
description: Prepared with dough, cherries, and almonds.
steps: Prepare strudel dough
Pit 7 deciliters of ripe sour cherries, stew them slightly and strain the juice
Mix 14 decagrams coarsely crushed almonds, 14 decagrams sugar, grated crumbly bread and finely chopped lemon peel
Stretch the dough finely and brush with melted butter
Spread the cherries evenly on it
Sprinkle the rest of the filling on top
Fold gently together
Place on a buttered parchment paper
Brush with melted butter and bake

title: Meggy-rétes tészta, élesztős tésztával (Sour Cherry Strudel with Yeast Dough)
description: Prepared with yeast, sour cream, and almonds.
steps: Beat 9 decagrams butter until fluffy and add 6 whole eggs one by one
Add 1.5 decagrams soaked yeast, 2 spoonfuls broken sugar, a little salt, 4 deciliters warm sour cream and enough flour so the dough is neither too thin nor too stiff
Let the dough rise well covered
Meanwhile grind 14 decagrams plumped almonds and 14 decagrams sugar
Stew 7 deciliters cherries, pit them and strain
When the dough has risen well, place on a cloth sprinkled with flour and stretch to knife-edge thickness
Only at the moment of use, mix the sugar and almonds and sprinkle on the dough
Place the strained cherries on top and sprinkle with broken sugar
Fold gently the edge of the dough that remained unfilled
Stretch the dough lengthwise so the strudel is not too thick
Place on a buttered baking sheet
Let rise for another quarter hour
Brush with egg white and sugar
Bake in gentle but sustained heat
When baked, place on a sieve and cool
Serve dusted with sugar
This can also be made the same way with crushed walnuts, sugar, vanilla and chopped raisins

title: Meggyet eczetbe becsinálni (Spanish Cherries in Vinegar)
description: Prepared with cherries, vinegar, and sugar.

ingredients.name: Spanish cherries with stems half-cut
ingredients.sourceText: 500 grams Spanish cherries with stems half-cut

steps: Place a few spoonfuls of sugar in a preserving jar.
Layer alternately: cherries, sugar, cherries, sugar, until all is used.
Pour 1 coffee cup of good white vinegar over it.
Tie the jar and leave in the sun for five to six days during which time the sugar dissolves.
Strain the liquid and cook it until it forms heavy drops.
Cool it, pour over the cherries, and tie closed only after 24 hours.

title: Meleg Szalonpudding (Warm Bacon Pudding)
description: A pudding made with egg yolks, sour cream, and powdered sugar.

ingredients.name: four and one half decilitres of good sour cream
ingredients.sourceText: four and one half decilitres of good sour cream

ingredients.name: ten dekagrams of candied fruit of various types
ingredients.sourceText: ten dekagrams of candied fruit of various types

steps: Beat eight egg yolks with four and one half decilitres of good sour cream
Add finely ground vanilla and powdered sugar to taste
Place the mixture over charcoal fire and stir until it begins to thicken
Remove quickly and stir for a few minutes so it does not curdle
Set aside until completely cooled
Cut ten dekagrams of various candied fruits into small cubes and mix into the cream
Gradually fold in the stiff whites of six eggs
Line a buttered mould with seven dekagrams of fine ladyfinger biscuits, placing them with their shiny sides facing outward and standing upright
Place the mixture in the mould
Steam for three quarters of an hour
Turn out and serve immediately

title: Meleg tojásos puncs (Warm Egg Punch)
description: Prepared with white wine, juice, and orange.

ingredients.name: half a bottle of Bakateri or other white wine
ingredients.sourceText: half a bottle of Bakateri or other white wine

ingredients.name: juice of two oranges and two lemons

steps: In a deep vessel, combine six whole eggs and twelve egg yolks with the sugar, stirring well together
Slowly add the wine, arak, and water, as well as the zest of one orange
Place the vessel in a pan over charcoal fire
Beat the mixture with birch twigs tied together until it thickens completely and fills the vessel with fine foam
Remove from heat and continue beating for six more minutes
Strain through a fine sieve into glasses

title: Menyhal kifejtett kagylóeskákkal és szarvasgombával (Lamprey with Shelled Shellfish and Mushrooms)
description: Prepared with lamprey, mushrooms, and onion.
steps: Clean the lamprey and form it into a ring, wash and salt it
Melt butter, stir in 2 teaspoons flour, add half an onion and a piece of lemon peel, dilute with pea broth in which roots have been cooked
Add the lamprey and bring to a boil so it remains whole, then strain the sauce and add lemon juice and bring to a boil again
Meanwhile, shell 25 small shellfish and cut 6-8 mushrooms into leaves, braise with fresh butter and finely chopped green parsley
Add {{source-10}}, 3-4 tablespoons sour cream, the shelled shellfish and braise together for several minutes
In a small cup, beat 2 egg yolks well, add the lamprey sauce, place the cup on a bed of coals and strain the sauce with continuous stirring
Place the lamprey in the center of the dish, pour a little sauce over it and arrange the shellfish and mushrooms in a wreath around the lamprey
